text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you,
Opera O-san, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Likewise, I look forward to working with you—Digital-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A major race that brings nerves even to the usually laid-back Meisho Doto.
And then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Welcome, Digital.
To my coronation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I acknowledge your hard work. With that tremendous late charge,
you caught up right behind us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, you must realize it.
You're not quite there yet! Yes, in raw ability!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
After all, I am the "End-of-Century Overlord"!
I reign supreme over medium-distance turf!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Right, Digital-kun?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes... That is correct...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it might look like a declaration of defeat.
However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent is the supreme Overlord herself... If I don't
properly acknowledge the gap between us, I'll never be able to turn the tables..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've acknowledged it, we have to do something...
Find some way to catch up...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's no point in brooding over it.
The Rubicon has already been crossed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! How could anything ever
possibly work out in your favor?!
No matter how one looks at it—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Drip, drop...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even if I think about it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaaaa...!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah, is that... rain...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What, rain...?! 
Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden downpour. A light drizzle would be one thing, but at this rate,
it might affect the track condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And if the track conditions worsen—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the weeping rain...
of the Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No... they must be tears of joy.
To celebrate my victory, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An all-rounder. That's precisely who I am,
someone who has walked every path without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A narrow path opens up at the very end!
Divine intervention, let's goooooo!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A heavy track for... the Tenno Sho...
Hmmm..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've run on every kind of track, so bad conditions
don't bother me at all! The mud is my home turf!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Under these conditions, Digi-tan will definitely—! God of Stanning, hear me! Make me even more, more—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unexpected foul weather. The sun was hidden,
and at the same time, a ray of hope
shone down upon Agnes Digital.
